question: The purchasing power of a currency relative to another at current exchange rates and prices is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **real exchange rate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **real exchange rate** measures the value of a currency against another, adjusted for price levels.
 
• It reflects the **purchasing power** of one currency in terms of another.
 
• The real exchange rate can indicate whether a currency is **overvalued or undervalued** compared to another.
 
• This rate is crucial for evaluating the **competitiveness** of a country's goods and services.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 The **nominal exchange rate** is the rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another without adjustments for price levels.
 
 

 Option 2
 The **real exchange rate** considers price level differences between countries.
 
 

 Option 3
 The **balance of payments** records all economic transactions between residents of a country and the rest of the world.
 
 

 Option 4
 **Purchasing power parity (PPP)** is a theory that states that in the long term, exchange rates should move towards the rate that would equalize the prices of an identical basket of goods and services in any two countries.
